cards.headline: The ‘Play, Instruct, Befriend’ approach to parenting
bullets: Parents can raise kids in three seven-year stages: Play, Instruct, and Befriend.
The first seven years focus on playing with kids to build a strong parent-child bond.
From age 7 to 14, parents should teach children values and set clear expectations.
The final seven years are for building friendship and guiding teenagers.

cards.headline: NYP students use virtual reality to help make cancer treatment rooms less frightening for children
bullets: NYP students created virtual reality games to help young cancer patients feel less scared before treatment.
The VR simulations let kids see and hear what treatment rooms are like.
This helps them understand procedures like CT scans and radiotherapy better.
Seventeen children, some as young as seven, have used the VR tool so far.
One parent said the VR game made her son more confident for his therapy sessions.

cards.headline: NUS study finds photosynthesis could treat dry eye disease
bullets: NUS researchers developed new eye drops using plant photosynthesis to treat dry eye disease.
The eye drops, called LEAF, help corneal cells produce their own energy using light.
Lab tests showed LEAF reduced cell damage and improved eye healing in rodents.
These new drops outperformed existing dry eye treatments in early tests.

cards.headline: Found: 14-year-old last seen in Woodlands on May 16
bullets: Police found missing 14-year-old Hans Rafael Yuhanis on May 17.
He was last seen near Causeway Point on May 16.
The teenager was reported missing by police on May 17.
He was last seen wearing a black t-shirt and black pants.

cards.headline: Hot, cold, repeat: Contrast bath therapy is the latest wellness trend – how does it work?
bullets: New bathhouses are opening in Singapore, offering hot and cold water dips.
This trend, called contrast bath therapy, involves switching between hot and cold temperatures.
The practice aims to improve blood circulation and train your nervous system.
Experts say cold plunges are generally safe for women, but avoid extremes.
Start with warm environments and gradually try cooler temperatures if you're new to this.

cards.headline: He once felt he had to prove himself in school. Today, Christopher Chua designs luxury resorts for top hotel brands
bullets: Christopher Chua designs luxury resorts for top hotel brands like Hilton and Four Seasons.
He founded Singapore-based KulorGroup, a firm that advises luxury hospitality names.
Chua once felt he had to prove himself due to his less well-off background.
He chose to pursue arts despite societal views that it was not respectable.
His firm acts as a strategic design partner, not just a designer or architect.

cards.headline: Police obtain footage of fake Zoom meeting in scam impersonating PM Wong
bullets: One person lost S$4.9 million in a scam using fake Zoom calls with AI impersonations.
Police have AI-generated video footage showing fake meetings with PM Wong and other officials.
Scammers impersonated government staff to invite victims to fake Zoom meetings.
The fake videos showed officials discussing the Strait of Hormuz and included a deepfake PM Wong.
Police warn that deepfake AI can create convincing fake videos and urge caution.

cards.headline: More than 18,000 HDB flats selected for upgrading works under Home Improvement Programme
bullets: Over 18,000 HDB flats are getting upgrades under the Home Improvement Programme.
More than S$253 million will be spent on these upgrading works.
The programme fixes common issues like spalling concrete and leaks.
It also offers optional upgrades like new doors at a low cost.

cards.headline: Malaysian delivery riders among 35 arrested for harassing Singapore borrowers in cross-border loan sharking crackdown
bullets: 35 people arrested in Singapore for loan shark harassment, including Malaysian delivery riders.
Loan sharks used delivery riders to intimidate borrowers in Singapore, sometimes sending pork.
Riders were recruited online, often unaware of the packages' true purpose.
Authorities in Malaysia and Singapore cooperated in the crackdown.

cards.headline: Man City’s FA Cup triumph shows the rewards of patience under Guardiola
bullets: Manchester City beat Chelsea 1-0 to win the FA Cup.
Antoine Semenyo scored the winning goal with a back-heel.
Manager Pep Guardiola has won 15 major trophies with Man City.
Guardiola credited the club's patience for their success.
Chelsea have now sacked five managers since 2022.

cards.headline: Former UFC champion Rousey rolls back the clock to submit Carano in 17 seconds
bullets: Ronda Rousey submitted Gina Carano in 17 seconds in her first fight in nearly 10 years.
Both fighters had not competed in mixed martial arts for several years.
Rousey used her signature armbar move to secure the quick victory.
Carano, fighting for the first time in 17 years, saw getting back in the cage as a win.

cards.headline: SingLand buys out UOB’s stake in Novena Square JVs for S$299 million
bullets: SingLand paid S$299 million to buy UOB's shares in Novena Square.
SingLand also bought UOB's banking hall space at Velocity@Novena Square for S$19.5 million.
This deal will give SingLand more regular income from the Novena Square property.
Novena Square is located above Novena MRT station and includes offices and a mall.

cards.headline: MG MG4 Urban review: Small EVs should be more like this for one reason
bullets: The MG4 Urban electric car costs S$184,888 with COE and offers 405 km range.
This practical electric car has a large boot space, expandable to 1,364 litres.
It charges to 80 per cent in 30 minutes using a DC fast charger.
The car includes a 10-year battery warranty and 10 years of free servicing.

cards.headline: At least 8 killed, 35 injured: Train crashes into public bus in Bangkok city centre
bullets: A train crashed into a bus in Bangkok, killing eight and injuring 35.
The collision caused a fire and multiple explosions.
The bus was reportedly stuck on the tracks during traffic.
The train driver may not have responded to warnings.

cards.headline: 2 M'sian sisters die in hit-&-run, one had been planning to celebrate Mother's Day with daughter the next day
bullets: Two Malaysian sisters died after being hit by an SUV in Klang.
One sister was visiting the other and they were out for a walk after dinner.
The sister who died was planning to celebrate Mother's Day with her daughter the next day.
Police have impounded a silver Mazda SUV involved in the incident.

cards.headline: First Look At Singapore International Festival Of Arts 2026 – Aerial Performance & Interactive Installations
bullets: The Singapore International Festival of Arts runs from May 15 to 30, 2026.
This year's festival is the start of a three-year journey to SIFA's 50th anniversary.
Expect aerial performances, interactive installations, and a festival parade.
Some shows, like 'The Lighthouse', cost $28, while others are free.
Food stalls and a special 'Makan Culture' experience are available at the Festival Village.

cards.headline: What Our Bus Network Could Look Like In 5 Years – Driverless Buses, New Bus Routes & Upgraded Interchanges
bullets: Driverless buses will start running on two routes by mid-2026.
660 new electric buses will be on our roads from late 2026.
Bus service 181 will extend to Tengah from June 2026.
Seven bus interchanges are getting upgraded by 2027.
A new bus interchange will open at Bedok South ITH in late 2026.
